name: Updates Researcher
intro: Build a private, editable briefing canvas using your saved agent.
flow: Choose an agent → write the brief → save → review and run
boundary: This is a manual research brief, not a news feed or daily automation. Saved profiles do not prove live access or current availability. Each managed tool call still needs its own approval.
sources_help: Supplied links are not fetched automatically. Managed source tools use the existing reviewed allowlist and individual approvals; tool names do not prove safety.
external: External client: a running client must take the task; it remains waiting until then.
managed: Managed text model assignment (configured, not tested here)
no_profiles: A profile alone does not provide live sources. Without approved source tools, prepare this brief from supplied text or configure a suitable MCP profile separately.
no_tools: No managed tools enabled. Use supplied text or open the tools editor to configure them separately. External-client tools are managed by that client.
shared: These editors change agent-wide settings for all its canvases. Consider a dedicated agent; reload this page after editing.
title: Recipe canvas title
instructions_default: Prepare a concise updates brief for the topic and time range supplied in the context. Use only supplied evidence or results of separately approved tools. For each finding give the source title, exact supplied source URL, publication date when available, and the date of the event. Distinguish evidence, inference and uncertainty; flag missing or conflicting dates and links. Never invent sources or claim live browsing. If no current evidence is available, say so. Return key updates, why they matter, unresolved questions and a human review checklist. Keep the result private; do not publish, send messages or schedule future runs.
context: Supplied topic, sources and time range
context_help: Paste approved source excerpts, URLs and dates. Text and links are saved as context; URLs are not automatically fetched. Do not paste credentials.
private: Output: a private note in the new canvas. This label names the agent task.
preview_help: Recipe preview only. The canvas’s run review also includes current agent skills, model and context.
consent: Save this private editable canvas. Grant access and approve execution separately.
next_help: This is a saved editable recipe. Review the prompt and context cards, then use the existing agent access controls to explicitly grant this board’s context and run scope. Saving this recipe granted nothing. Open the agent card’s run review to inspect the exact prompt, model, context and current tools before confirming. Each managed tool call requires a separate approval. External-client tasks wait for a running client. Results stay private; there is no recurring schedule.
manager: This example is available to editors. A settings and agent-key manager must choose their own active agent to configure connections and save a recipe.
stale: The agent configuration changed or is unavailable. Reload its configuration and preview again. No recipe was saved.
invalid: Check the required fields and preview the recipe before saving. No recipe was saved.
unavailable: This agent’s saved bundle, model or connection needs review. Open its configuration, then reload this page. Nothing was saved.
limit: You have reached the 100-canvas limit. Remove an unneeded canvas from your saved canvases, then preview and save again. No recipe was saved.
conflict: This draft already exists with different content. Reopen your saved canvas, or copy your edits and reload the recipe to start a separate draft. Nothing was replaced.
failed: The recipe could not be saved because of a server error. Your edits remain below. Try previewing and saving again; contact the administrator if it continues.
